name: Warlord Thrane
_doc: Expansion 1 (Vharlen). The ZONE EVENT BOSS for the Pumice Wastes: the Slagborn warlord marches on Lastwell Stockade. P1 'The Warcry': a cleaver cone, flaming arrows, and a war stamp that throws everyone near him. P2 at 55% 'The Pyre Line': his firecallers chant a ward over him — KILL THE FIRECALLERS to drop it — while burning ground spreads. P3, a new health bar 'Thrane Alone': three charges in a row down the field, a slag brand that three players must share, and a get-in-close ring. Soft enrage from 4 minutes, hard at 7.
party: Zone event, everyone nearby joins. Solo: not intended (three firecallers to kill, a stack of 3). 3-5: playable. 10+: intended. M5 scaling: health and firecallers by players enrolled; stack need = clamp(players/4, 2, 5).

pull: Lastwell! Open the gate or I open it for you.
Warlord Thrane plants his standard in the pumice. The drums start.
The mountain sent me. The mountain is hungry.
say.death: Warlord Thrane falls across his own standard. The drums stop.
say.reset: Warlord Thrane pulls his standard and marches back into the waste.

enrage.say: Thrane roars and the whole waste catches fire!

soft.say: The drums beat faster. The warband sings.

stamp.name: War Stamp
stamp.say: Thrane lifts his boot — get clear!

burning_ground.name: Burning Ground
burning_ground.say: The firecallers set the ground alight!

charges.name: Triple Charge
charges.say: Thrane charges — and charges — and charges! Watch the lines!

slag_brand.name: Slag Brand
slag_brand.say: Thrane brands {target} — three of you share the burn!

war_ring.name: Warlord's Ring
war_ring.say: Fire rings the warlord — get in close!

phases.name: The Pyre Line
phases.shieldDown: The last firecaller falls silent — the pyre ward collapses!

onEnter.say: Thrane stands in a ring of chanting firecallers. Kill all three firecallers to drop the ward! It fails by itself in 25 seconds.

ward.say: Thrane stands in a ring of chanting firecallers. Kill all three firecallers to drop the ward! It fails by itself in 25 seconds.
ward.fade: The ward fails by itself. No opening this time.

phases.name: Thrane Alone
phases.say: Fine. The old way, then. Me and my cleaver.
